title: VersionerReborn
description: A highly flexible version checking tool, designed specifically for modpack developers.
body:
A highly flexible version checking tool, designed specifically for modpack developers.
It can **fetch JSON files** containing version information from a fixed network location and notify players when there are updates.
It also **displays the current and latest version information** on the main interface, as well as whether an update is needed.
In addition, it can **dynamically retrieve a list of sponsors** from the network, JSON-formatted welcome messages, and other serializable variables.
Created by shinrasky, the Versioner by TCreopargh was migrated from 1.12.2 to 1.21.1
